description: In this FSY-style performance, a youth choir sings a medley of hymns focused on discipleship and trust in the Savior. The simple harmonies invite a peaceful spirit and show how group performances can uplift an entire audience.

This example features a group of young men and women singing ‘Called to Serve’ with reverence and energy. Their preparation and unity demonstrate how music can strengthen testimony and build confidence among FSY participants.

A combined youth choir performs ‘I Feel My Savior’s Love’ in a soft, reverent arrangement. The simplicity of the piece helps everyone reflect on their personal relationship with Jesus Christ and feel closer to Him.
